events.text:
## Recommendation

- **Go to South Haven's pier.** My estimate is **2 of 4** (average), the best of the four ports.
- **Fish spinners and spoons, plus shrimp under a bobber.** Expect coho and steelhead more than Chinook.
- **Second choice: St. Joseph (1 of 4).** The evidence there is thin.
- **Grand Haven and Muskegon (both 1 of 4).** Expect slow pier fishing. If you can get on a boat, it has been the better bet there.

My estimates for the pier this week: St. Joseph 1, South Haven 2, Grand Haven 1, Muskegon 1.

## Why

- **South Haven has the most recent pier success.** I'd expect the best pier action there this week, since the Aug 27 report was the only recent one with a rated pier catch.
- **The pier at Grand Haven and Muskegon has mostly been slow.** Those piers were slow or only a few fish in three of the last four weeks, so I'd expect little better this week.
- **Boats have outperformed the pier at Grand Haven and Muskegon.** Boat anglers there had good or average catches on spoons and flies in 50 to 160 feet of water, while pier anglers struggled.
- **Past early Septembers match this pattern.** In past Septembers, pier anglers at Grand Haven and Muskegon were mostly slow, while St. Joseph's pier had a good week after an upwelling in 2024. I'd expect that to be a one-off, not a reliable pattern.

## Evidence

**Recent reports (newest is Aug 27, six days before today)**

- **South Haven pier (Aug 27):** coho were caught on "spinners and spoons, as well as shrimp fished under bobbers," rated 2 (average). No Chinook pier catch was reported. (South Haven, 2025-08-27)
- **Grand Haven pier (Aug 27):** "Pier anglers caught salmon on alewives and while casting glow spoons," not rated. Earlier weeks were slow: 0 on Aug 20 and Aug 13. (Grand Haven, 2025-08-27; 2025-08-20; 2025-08-13)
- **Muskegon pier (Aug 27):** "a few salmon while casting glow spoons," rated 1 (below average). Earlier weeks were 0 on Aug 13 and Aug 6. (Muskegon, 2025-08-27; 2025-08-13; 2025-08-06)
- **St. Joseph pier:** The only recent pier mention is Aug 6: "steelhead and the occasional Chinook salmon using shrimp," rated 1. No pier report there for Aug 13, 20 or 27. (St. Joseph, 2025-08-06)
- **Boats (Aug 27):** Grand Haven boats had "decent numbers" to 80 feet on glow spoons and plugs, rated 2. South Haven boats had "fair success" with fish from 35 feet out past 120 feet, mostly on spoons, rated 2. St. Joseph boats were rated 2 at about 70 feet. (Grand Haven, Muskegon, South Haven, St. Joseph, 2025-08-27)

**Past seasons (similar water temperature, within three weeks of today, labeled as history)**

- **St. Joseph pier, Sept 11, 2024:** "good numbers of salmon" on spinners and spoons, rated 3, during a week with a sharp drop in surface water. (St. Joseph, 2024-09-11)
- **South Haven pier, Aug 28, 2024:** good early in the week on salmon and steelhead, then slowed. Rated 2. (South Haven, 2024-08-28)
- **Grand Haven and Muskegon piers, September 2022 and 2024:** mostly rated 0 (slow). (Grand Haven, 2024-09-18; 2022-09-14; 2022-09-07; Muskegon, 2024-09-18; 2022-09-07)

**Conditions now (buoy surface water, the week before today)**

- St. Joseph: 72 F, flat over the week (St. Joseph buoy 45026).
- South Haven: 70 F, flat over the week (South Haven buoy 45168).
- Grand Haven and Muskegon: 65 F, up 9 F over the week (Grand Haven buoy 45161).

The tool returned a backtest summary, not live data. It did not include modeled pierhead water temperature, the modeled cold-layer depth, or a wind forecast.

## Caveats

- **The reports are old.** The newest is from Aug 27, six days ago, and the season changes fast in early fall. Check the DNR bulletin and the local wind before you go.
- **The conditions data is not live.** It is a summary for the week before today, with no pierhead water or wind forecast. I couldn't tell whether an upwelling is under way at the piers.
- **Several ratings are thin.** St. Joseph has no recent pier report, and Grand Haven's latest pier catch was not rated, which I count as a weak positive.
- **Coho and steelhead are the likeliest catch at South Haven.** Its pier report named coho and steelhead, not Chinook.
